messages:
Matt S.: Quick heads-up — PR #8427 is ready for review but blocked on architecture sign-off. RFC link: https://rfc.redwood.ai/rfc/187-kv-routing (see sections 3–5).
Sophia L.: thanks — can you paste which exact parts need arch ack?
Matt S.: sure — the merge is gated on: 1) confirmation of fallback behavior (sec 4.2), 2) KV cache invalidation semantics (sec 4.4), and 3) perf numbers for p50/p95/p99 on our small-batch profile. I added a short summary in the PR description and referenced `rfc:187`.
Kevin H.: CI looks green on linux, flaky on mac but no regressions. Buildkite: https://build.redwood.ai/builds/8427 :white_check_mark:
arch-team: quick note — we'll need explicit ack from @Sarah R. and @Dmitri V. before merge. please add a one-paragraph migration plan in the RFC (how old prefix keys map during rollout).
Matt S.: added migration paragraph and a tiny table. PTAL in the RFC (sec 5.1). Also removed a TODO from handler per Sophia's earlier comment.
Sophia L.: nice, thanks. small nit: please expand the table header to indicate units (tokens/sec).
Matt S.: done — table updated and pushed to PR branch.
Sarah R.: reading now, will comment with any concerns by EOD. main ask so far: include sequence-length perf numbers and CPU p99 for 8/16 sequence lengths.
Dmitri V.: same for me — need a short note describing how cache invalidation is triggered during rollout and whether we re-warm the cache. once that's in i'm ok to sign.
Matt S.: adding perf runs (local harness) and a simple cache re-warm plan. attaching results in PR comment with `perf/branch-187.log`.
Sophia L.: tiny follow-up — PR description mentions changing the public route key format; do we need a deprecation notice for clients?
Matt S.: added deprecation note and a quick compatibility shim in the handler to accept both formats for 30 days.
rfc-bot: RFC 187 status update: reviewers assigned: @Sarah R., @Dmitri V. — status: under-review.
deploy-bot: CI finished: buildkite/8427 succeeded. merge action blocked: outstanding rfc-approval.
Dmitri V.: reviewed and left inline comments on cache invalidation. updated RFC with the re-warm plan. approving RFC 187 now.
arch-team: RFC 187 accepted by @Dmitri V. awaiting final arch stamp.
Sarah R.: LGTM on RFC 187 after small wording tweak (clarified fallback priority). approving now.
arch-team: arch LGTM :thumbsup: — PR gating condition satisfied.
Matt S.: thanks all. I'll merge in the 1:00–2:00am deploy window to reduce risk. will monitor traces and latency dashboards after rollout. :tada:
Sophia L.: awesome — please post post-merge note with a link to the perf dashboard.
Matt S.: will do.
